objective: Recovery quirurgico de GATE 3F-A MPRO CANARY DESIGN DISCOVERY. Mantener exactamente el mismo alcance READ ONLY y resolver los bloqueadores de diseno previos a un canary: mecanismo observable de Pc_ID, mapping real de forma de pago y estado, obligatoriedad condicional de Pago_Cxp_Comprobante/Pago_CXP_Impuesto, lookup post-write determinista y fuente observable de saldo. No ejecutar canary, no escribir, no implementar Payment Executor.

queries.name: f3a_mpro_runtime_identity
queries.sql: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name,DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: f3a_mpro_pc_id_shape
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total,COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT Pc_ID) AS pc_id_distintos,SUM(CASE WHEN Pc_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pc_id_nulls,MIN(LEN(Pc_ID)) AS min_len,MAX(LEN(Pc_ID)) AS max_len,SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(bigint,Pc_ID) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numeric_like FROM dbo.Pago_CXP

queries.name: f3a_mpro_pc_id_frequency
queries.sql: SELECT Pc_ID,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total FROM dbo.Pago_CXP GROUP BY Pc_ID ORDER BY total DESC,Pc_ID

queries.name: f3a_mpro_pc_id_by_folio_multiplicity
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS folios_con_multiples FROM (SELECT Cxp_Folio FROM dbo.Pago_CXP GROUP BY Cxp_Folio HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) q

queries.name: f3a_mpro_form_state_shape
queries.sql: SELECT Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago,Es_Cve_Estado,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total FROM dbo.Pago_CXP GROUP BY Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago,Es_Cve_Estado ORDER BY Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago,Es_Cve_Estado

queries.name: f3a_mpro_form_catalog
queries.sql: SELECT fp.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago,COUNT_BIG(p.Cxp_Folio) AS pagos_observados FROM dbo.Forma_Pago fp LEFT JOIN dbo.Pago_CXP p ON p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago=fp.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago GROUP BY fp.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago ORDER BY fp.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago

queries.name: f3a_mpro_state_catalog
queries.sql: SELECT e.Es_Cve_Estado,COUNT_BIG(p.Cxp_Folio) AS pagos_observados FROM dbo.Estado e LEFT JOIN dbo.Pago_CXP p ON p.Es_Cve_Estado=e.Es_Cve_Estado GROUP BY e.Es_Cve_Estado ORDER BY e.Es_Cve_Estado

queries.name: f3a_mpro_child_presence
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_pagos,SUM(CASE WHEN c.Cxp_Folio IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_comprobante,SUM(CASE WHEN i.Cxp_Folio IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_impuesto FROM dbo.Pago_CXP p LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Cxp_Folio,Pc_ID FROM dbo.Pago_Cxp_Comprobante) c ON c.Cxp_Folio=p.Cxp_Folio AND c.Pc_ID=p.Pc_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Cxp_Folio,Pc_ID FROM dbo.Pago_CXP_Impuesto) i ON i.Cxp_Folio=p.Cxp_Folio AND i.Pc_ID=p.Pc_ID

queries.name: f3a_mpro_child_by_form
queries.sql: SELECT p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago,COUNT_BIG(*) AS pagos,SUM(CASE WHEN c.Cxp_Folio IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_comprobante,SUM(CASE WHEN i.Cxp_Folio IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_impuesto FROM dbo.Pago_CXP p LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Cxp_Folio,Pc_ID FROM dbo.Pago_Cxp_Comprobante) c ON c.Cxp_Folio=p.Cxp_Folio AND c.Pc_ID=p.Pc_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT Cxp_Folio,Pc_ID FROM dbo.Pago_CXP_Impuesto) i ON i.Cxp_Folio=p.Cxp_Folio AND i.Pc_ID=p.Pc_ID GROUP BY p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago ORDER BY p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago

queries.name: f3a_mpro_cxp_columns_for_confirmation
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Cuenta_X_Pagar') AND (c.name LIKE N'%Saldo%' OR c.name LIKE N'%Import%' OR c.name LIKE N'%Pago%' OR c.name LIKE N'%Estado%' OR c.name=N'Cxp_Folio') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: f3a_mpro_pago_lookup_index
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,ic.key_ordinal,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i INNER JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_CXP') ORDER BY i.index_id,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: f3a_mpro_pc_id_generators_metadata
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,OBJECT_DEFINITION(o.object_id) AS definition FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE OBJECT_DEFINITION(o.object_id) LIKE N'%Pc_ID%' OR OBJECT_DEFINITION(o.object_id) LIKE N'%Pago_CXP%' ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name

constraints: NO INSERT UPDATE DELETE MERGE EXEC EXECUTE DDL SELECT INTO OR MULTI-STATEMENT SQL
NO individual provider, invoice or payment business rows except bounded code/catalog values required to resolve form/state/Pc_ID design
Connections only through PosRuntimeResolver and get_external_sql_connection
Do not invent Pc_ID generation if no authoritative mechanism is found
Do not authorize child-table writes from correlation alone
Do not authorize any canary or Payment Executor writer
